text:
Alex Chen: heads-up — we saw a spike in fncall schema rejects this morning for tenant: beta-1234 and the billing graph still shows tokens billed via the degen fallback route. wondering if this is a dashboard mapping / telemetry gap or an actual charge bug. cc @Samir @Maria
Samir Patel: can you paste a minimal repro? which model variant + route_id?
Alex Chen: request was hitting route_id=chat-fncall-prod, model=redwood-llama-v2-13b, example payload (PII redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
{
  "input": "Finish order details",
  "functions": [{"name":"create_order","parameters":{"type":"object","required":["order_id","items"],"properties":{/*...*/}}}],
  "allow_fallback": true
}
```
response logged from orchestrator: `fncall_validation=hard_reject missing required property order_id` and then a follow-up generated fallback from degen-model with tokens billed.
Maria Gomez: ugh this is the classic telemetry missing dimension. our billing pipeline currently attributes tokens to the final model that served, not to the outcome of upstream validators. we should tag events with `fncall_schema_outcome`.
Jamie Lee: is the UI showing the reject reason anywhere for the user? or just a 5xx/empty output? if console doesn't surface it, support will get confused.
Alex Chen: console shows a generic "function call rejected" in the logs, but the metrics dashboard only has `fncall.reject_count` and `tokens.by_model`. no join key to link the two, so ops can't filter out billed tokens caused by upstream validation rejects.
Samir Patel: quick ask: would adding a `validation_result` field on the request/response trace be enough for dashboards? values: `accept | coerced | soft_reject | hard_reject`. then we can change the billing view to filter tokens where validation_result!=accept.
Maria Gomez: that's my suggested approach too. also add `validation_reason` for human-readable label (e.g. "missing order_id"). ingestion change is small but needs schema bump in honeycomb/trace proto.
ci-bot: deploy pipeline: ingest-service v3.12.0 deployed to staging (sha: abcd1234) :rocket:
Samir Patel: ingestion team can add the extra fields, but we need to make sure downstream charge computation (billing-job) doesn't break on unknown enums — fallback to `accept` in old code will cause charges to remain, so explicit migration required.
Jamie Lee: rollout UX idea: in the Console -> Routes view add a toggle "exclude validation rejects from billable tokens" (off by default). Canary to 10% orgs first. ops can opt in while we verify correctness.
Alex Chen: also the alert we have for `fncall.reject_count` fires, but it doesn't include route_id or trace_id. Attached logs show trace: trace_id=tr-0a1b2c3d. Snippet: 
```
[orchestrator] trace=tr-0a1b2c3d fn=create_order outcome=hard_reject reason=missing order_id
[router] trace=tr-0a1b2c3d routed=degen-1 model=redwood-degen-7b tokens=432
```
Samir Patel: nice, include that trace in the bug. I'll open GH issue and link to internal ticket. we should also add a unit test in billing to assert tokens attributed = tokens where outcome==accept.
Maria Gomez: telemetry pipeline note: when we add `fncall_schema_outcome` we should emit it at both the validator and the router stage. That allows us to sanity-check "router changed outcome" cases. Also suggest a metric `fncall.charge_mismatch` when tokens are billed but outcome!=accept.
Jamie Lee: ok agreed. owners? I'll take dashboard + Console toggle UX. Samir you take ingestion + billing-job changes. Maria you take telemetry instrumentation and metric definition. Alex please paste full redacted request/response bundle into the GH issue and link the trace. We'll sync Friday 09:00 PT to triage, and canary the console toggle to 10% orgs after ingestion rollout. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: will do, filing now and attaching logs + trace. thanks all. :pray:
ci-bot: ticket created: ENG-1742 (internal link)
Samir Patel: +1, will add tests and a migration plan to avoid misattribution during rollout.
Maria Gomez: I'll draft the metric contract and example queries for dashboards.
Jamie Lee: great — moving this to a short RFC doc. Meeting invite incoming.
Alex Chen: thanks!
